readings: Join sentiment snapshots to transaction records on transref = transreg and to traders on trdref = tradereg, keeping only full matches. For each (transaction reference, trader type) pair, average the nonmissing optvolrt values. Compute the overall average optvolrt across all matched sentiment snapshots, counting each snapshot once; return no rows if that average is missing. Define each pair's deviation as its pair average minus the overall average. Within each nonmissing trader type, compute the average deviation across its pairs and keep only pairs with a deviation greater than that type average. Define excess as pair deviation minus type average deviation. For each trader type, report the averages across retained pairs of their option volume ratio, deviation, and excess, ignoring missing values and without rounding.

Join sentiment snapshots to transaction records on transref = transreg and to traders on trdref = tradereg, keeping only full matches. For each (transaction reference, trader type) pair, average the nonmissing optvolrt values. Compute the overall average of those pair averages, giving each pair equal weight; return no rows if that average is missing. Define each pair's deviation as its pair average minus the overall average. Within each nonmissing trader type, compute the average deviation across its pairs and keep only pairs with a deviation greater than that type average. Define excess as pair deviation minus type average deviation. For each trader type, report the averages across retained pairs of their option volume ratio, deviation, and excess, ignoring missing values and without rounding.

Join sentiment snapshots to transaction records on transref = transreg and to traders on trdref = tradereg, keeping only full matches. For each (transaction reference, trader type) pair, average the nonmissing optvolrt values. Compute the overall average optvolrt across all matched sentiment snapshots, counting each snapshot once; return no rows if that average is missing. Define each pair's deviation as the absolute difference between its pair average and the overall average. Within each nonmissing trader type, compute the average deviation across its pairs and keep only pairs with a deviation greater than that type average. Define excess as pair deviation minus type average deviation. For each trader type, report the averages across retained pairs of their option volume ratio, deviation, and excess, ignoring missing values and without rounding.

Join sentiment snapshots to transaction records on transref = transreg and to traders on trdref = tradereg, keeping only full matches. For each (transaction reference, trader type) pair, average the nonmissing optvolrt values. Compute the overall average of those pair averages, giving each pair equal weight; return no rows if that average is missing. Define each pair's deviation as the absolute difference between its pair average and the overall average. Within each nonmissing trader type, compute the average deviation across its pairs and keep only pairs with a deviation greater than that type average. Define excess as pair deviation minus type average deviation. For each trader type, report the averages across retained pairs of their option volume ratio, deviation, and excess, ignoring missing values and without rounding.
queries:
WITH matched AS (
    SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, s.optvolrt
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
    JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON s.transref = r.transreg
    JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt
    FROM matched
),
pair_averages AS (
    SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) AS pair_avg
    FROM matched
    WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY transref, tradekind
    HAVING AVG(optvolrt) IS NOT NULL
),
deviations AS (
    SELECT p.tradekind, p.pair_avg,
           p.pair_avg - o.avg_optvolrt AS deviation
    FROM pair_averages AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE o.avg_optvolrt IS NOT NULL
),
type_averages AS (
    SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) AS type_avg_deviation
    FROM deviations
    GROUP BY tradekind
)
SELECT d.tradekind,
       AVG(d.pair_avg) AS avg_optvolrt,
       AVG(d.deviation) AS avg_deviation,
       AVG(d.deviation - t.type_avg_deviation) AS avg_excess
FROM deviations AS d
JOIN type_averages AS t ON d.tradekind = t.tradekind
WHERE d.deviation > t.type_avg_deviation
GROUP BY d.tradekind

WITH pair_averages AS (
    SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS pair_avg
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
    JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON s.transref = tr.transreg
    JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
    GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind
),
deviations AS (
    SELECT transref, tradekind, pair_avg,
           pair_avg - (SELECT AVG(pair_avg) FROM pair_averages) AS deviation
    FROM pair_averages
    WHERE pair_avg IS NOT NULL
      AND tradekind IS NOT NULL
),
type_averages AS (
    SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) AS type_avg_deviation
    FROM deviations
    GROUP BY tradekind
)
SELECT d.tradekind,
       AVG(d.pair_avg) AS avg_optvolrt,
       AVG(d.deviation) AS avg_deviation,
       AVG(d.deviation - ta.type_avg_deviation) AS avg_excess
FROM deviations AS d
JOIN type_averages AS ta ON d.tradekind = ta.tradekind
WHERE d.deviation > ta.type_avg_deviation
GROUP BY d.tradekind

WITH matched AS (
    SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, s.optvolrt
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
    INNER JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON s.transref = tr.transreg
    INNER JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS overall_avg
    FROM matched
),
pairs AS (
    SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) AS pair_avg
    FROM matched
    WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY transref, tradekind
),
deviations AS (
    SELECT p.tradekind,
           p.pair_avg,
           ABS(p.pair_avg - o.overall_avg) AS deviation
    FROM pairs AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
),
type_averages AS (
    SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) AS type_avg_deviation
    FROM deviations
    GROUP BY tradekind
)
SELECT d.tradekind,
       AVG(d.pair_avg) AS avg_optvolrt,
       AVG(d.deviation) AS avg_deviation,
       AVG(d.deviation - a.type_avg_deviation) AS avg_excess
FROM deviations AS d
INNER JOIN type_averages AS a ON d.tradekind = a.tradekind
WHERE d.deviation > a.type_avg_deviation
GROUP BY d.tradekind

WITH pair_averages AS (
    SELECT
        s.transref,
        t.tradekind,
        AVG(s.optvolrt) AS pair_avg
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
    JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON s.transref = r.transreg
    JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg
    GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(pair_avg) AS overall_avg
    FROM pair_averages
),
deviations AS (
    SELECT
        p.tradekind,
        p.pair_avg,
        ABS(p.pair_avg - o.overall_avg) AS deviation
    FROM pair_averages AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
    WHERE p.tradekind IS NOT NULL
      AND p.pair_avg IS NOT NULL
      AND o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
),
type_averages AS (
    SELECT
        tradekind,
        AVG(deviation) AS type_avg_deviation
    FROM deviations
    GROUP BY tradekind
)
SELECT
    d.tradekind,
    AVG(d.pair_avg) AS avg_optvolrt,
    AVG(d.deviation) AS avg_deviation,
    AVG(d.deviation - a.type_avg_deviation) AS avg_excess
FROM deviations AS d
JOIN type_averages AS a ON d.tradekind = a.tradekind
WHERE d.deviation > a.type_avg_deviation
GROUP BY d.tradekind
